title: Build and inspect the output
summary: A static build produces HTML and assets that a static host can serve.
introduction: A static build produces HTML and assets that a static host can serve. Your task: Inspect a generated page and check its image requests.
learningObjectives: Inspect a generated page and check its image requests.
Explain the example for build and inspect the output

blocks.text: A static build produces HTML and assets that a static host can serve. Inspecting the output helps you see how little client code a content page needs.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.

blocks.code:
npm run build
npm run preview
blocks.title: Build and inspect the output

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The build command creates generated files under dist.
Preview serves those generated files locally so you can check their actual paths.

blocks.text: Astro builds the site to dist and starts a local preview using the project's preview command.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Preview is a local check, not a deployment by itself. Test generated route links and missing assets before publishing.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Inspect a generated page and check its image requests.
